sentences.l2: 凛とした寒気が窓ガラスを伝い、室内の空気を凍てつかせようとしている。
sentences.l1: A crisp, bracing cold creeps along the windowpane, trying to freeze the air in the room.

sentences.l2: しかし、窓辺に佇む幼き我が子の瞳は、白銀に覆われた庭先へと注がれ、抑えきれない生命の衝動に駆られていた。
sentences.l1: However, the eyes of my young child, standing by the window, were fixed on the yard covered in silver-white, and he was driven by an irrepressible impulse of life.

sentences.l2: 厳冬の冷たさなど意に介さず、ただ純粋に外で遊ぶための準備に余念がないのだ。
sentences.l1: Paying no mind to the coldness of the harsh winter, he is purely and wholly absorbed in getting ready to play outside.

sentences.l2: 彼は不器用ながらも、分厚いコートの袖に腕を通し、冷気から身を守るための鎧を着る。
sentences.l1: Though clumsily, he puts his arms through the sleeves of a thick coat, putting on armour to protect himself from the cold air.

sentences.l2: 凍てつく空気の中、ボタンを一つひとつ留める仕草には、未知の領域へ挑む戦士のような厳粛ささえ漂っていた。
sentences.l1: In the freezing air, his gesture of fastening the buttons one by one even carried a solemnity like that of a warrior challenging an unknown realm.

sentences.l2: やがて準備が整い、彼は勢いよく扉を押し開ける。
sentences.l1: Before long, the preparations are complete, and he vigorously pushes the door open.

sentences.l2: 苛烈な寒風が頬を打つ外の世界へと、無垢な好奇心を携えて駆け出していくその背中には、人間が本来備えている、過酷な環境をも楽しみへと変貌させる逞しさが凝縮されていたのである。
sentences.l1: In his back, as he runs out with innocent curiosity into the outside world where the fierce cold wind strikes his cheeks, was condensed the toughness that human beings inherently possess, which transforms even a harsh environment into enjoyment.
